integrity: The result is proved by the exact rank-inequality description of the base polytope, orthogonal projection of each subset normal to the affine hull, and finite linear-programming duality. No finite experiment or database nonappearance is used as a mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for connected matroids and the intrinsic Euclidean metric on the affine hull of the base polytope. Its fractional-partition characterization may have exponentially many variables before redundant rank inequalities are removed. It does not claim an analogous formula for disconnected matroids without modifying the intrinsic normal projection to their smaller affine hull.
title: The inradius of every connected matroid base polytope is a fractional-partition ratio
